original_test_intent: Verify the separate 16-bit Type 4 Thread Count 2 member encodes the approved per-socket logical-thread capacity, is selected correctly by the legacy Thread Count byte and is consistent with the extended enabled-core/SMT topology across reboot.
original_method: Capture raw Type 4 structures, ensure formatted length includes Thread Count 2, extract the extended UINT16 by specification offset, preserve the legacy thread byte, validate selector and threads-per-enabled-core relationships, reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user approves extended thread values, SMT and enabled-core relationships, raw-field specification and reboot plan. Field-level verification is automatable.
required_inputs: Applicable SMBIOS revision and minimum Type 4 length/offset for Thread Count 2
Expected 16-bit Thread Count 2 value per populated socket
Expected Enabled Core Count 2 and approved SMT threads-per-core ratio
Validated raw SMBIOS parser plus approved reboot and OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS/topology sources; do not toggle SMT, online/offline CPUs, change core settings or modify firmware.
Do not infer field absence from a missing `ThreadCount2` line; capture raw bytes and formatted length.
Bounds-check the raw read and retain legacy Thread Count, Thread Count 2 and Enabled Core Count 2 together.
Validate thread-to-enabled-core consistency only with the approved SMT ratio; an OS online mask is not this encoded capacity field.
Stop on unsupported length, invalid selector, impossible SMT relationship, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Directly extract Thread Count 2 per Type 4 structure, validate selector and enabled-core/SMT consistency, and compare raw values before/after reboot.
Do not substitute normalized decoder or OS counts, change SMT state or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve extended thread values, SMBIOS layout, SMT ratio and enabled-core relationship.
Approve reboot/recovery and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The literal compact label is not portable across decoders and cannot show raw field presence, bounds or selector consistency.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use a raw Type 4 parser to retain formatted length, legacy Thread Count byte, Thread Count 2 and Enabled Core Count 2; keep decoded/OS output only as supporting context.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The dedicated ThreadCount2 scope, Type 4 script and 10/10-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Decode Thread Count 2 directly from each sufficiently long Type 4 structure, confirm legacy selection and compare the 16-bit thread value with approved Enabled Core Count 2 and SMT ratio before and after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 4 records whose revision/length includes Thread Count 2.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, Type 4 length, BIOS/SMT policy, CPU topology and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 4 Thread Count 2 layout/selection semantics, approved CPU/SMT topology and installed parser documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Uses direct raw-field evidence and internal topology consistency instead of a decoder-dependent literal grep.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Improves coverage by proving the actual extended encoding and its selector/SMT relationships.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Extended thread baseline, enabled-core value and SMT policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS-visible logical CPUs may differ because of boot limits or offline state and cannot replace the raw firmware field.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a SKU/BIOS-specific SMT ratio or SMT-off topology, but must state the exact extended thread and enabled-core values; normalized or transient OS counts are not substitutes.
expected_evidence: Approved Thread Count 2/Enabled Core Count 2/SMT matrix, field definition and parser versions
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 4 bytes with socket/handle, length, legacy byte and extended thread/core values
Bounds, selector and threads-per-enabled-core consistency results
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot raw comparison
Engineer verdict or revision/length-based not-applicable determination
